audience: researchers and operations teams using ScrapeOwl for public website data

useCases.title: Inspect scraping capacity
useCases.text: Read account credit, request and concurrency counters before planning page retrievals. This does not scrape a page.

useCases.title: Retrieve a public page as HTML
useCases.text: Confirm vendor credit usage to fetch one public page without JavaScript. The tool makes no automatic retry and returns untrusted website content.

useCases.title: Extract structured page content
useCases.text: Choose up to 20 CSS or XPath selectors and confirm the vendor credit cost to extract content from one public page.

useCases.title: Read a page that needs JavaScript
useCases.text: Confirm the vendor credit cost to render a public page and retrieve its HTML, without custom scripts, cookies or form submissions.
